title: The Lords of Cornhole
overview: When Randall is informed that he has four weeks to pay Justine, the local drug lord, back the $20,000 he owes her due to his debilitating drug habit, he enlists the help of his best friend to enter into the state cornhole championship in order to raise the money. With local detectives hot on his trail due to a botched bank robbery, the walls are closing in on Randall, and time is running out!
